summary: 1930s lookout on a platform atop a garage at Midvale, now East Glacier Park; listed as abandoned and gone, with no source describing the site today.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone. No source describes what, if anything, remains at the site today.

events.note: Listing gives only 'the 1930s'; 1930 is a placeholder year for that decade, not a date any source gives.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: firelookout.com is the only source found for the lookout itself (1930s, platform atop a garage, abandoned, gone, 4825 ft). The listing gives the location as 'Glacier National Park in East Glacier'; no fetched source says whether the village lies inside or outside the park, so check that wording. The Montana History Portal gives 4792 ft for the community, a different point from the lookout's 4825 ft. The brief's record coordinates (48.44612, -113.22172) were not checked against a second source. Story sentence 'the community was home to Glacier Park Lodge and the Glacier Park Transportation Company's garages' does not link the lookout to any garage; the listing does not name the garage. No staffing, fire or rental information found. SummitPost, yournpguide, the NPS Glacier Tumblr post and the Hiking in Glacier blog did not mention Midvale. The willhiteweb Glacier page would not load (HTTP 500).
